slice: rider fit and ergonomics: lever, pedal and bar-holder adjustment, Yamaha YZ owner's service manuals 2020-2027

not_found.item: millimetre offsets of the YZ bar holders
not_found.searched: owner's service manuals, Yamaha feature pages
not_found.result: not printed; shown only in figures

records.statement: Yamaha's 2021 YZ125 owner's service manual: front brake lever position (the lever-to-grip distance in the manual's figure) is 100 mm as standard, adjustable over 86-105 mm with the adjusting bolt and locknut, and there should be no free play at the lever end; the cable clutch needs 7.0-12.0 mm free play at the lever, and lever position has its own adjuster and locknut; brake pedal height is set with an adjusting bolt and locknut, then checked for brake drag; the lower handlebar holders are offset, so fitting them the other way round moves the bar fore-aft.
records.notes: Yamaha manuals do not print the size of the holder offset; the press material calls it a four-position clamp.

records.topic: 2023 YZ450F: four-position rubber-mounted bar clamp, more seat-to-peg legroom
records.statement: Yamaha describes the 2023 YZ450F's handlebar clamp as four-position adjustable and rubber-mounted, with a revised bar position and more legroom between seat and footpegs than before.

source.name: Yamaha Motor USA, 2023 YZ450F features page

records.notes: Yamaha gives no millimetre figures for the four positions.

records.topic: Yamaha tall seat accessory (+19 mm), 250F / FX models
records.statement: Yamaha sells a tall seat about 3/4 in (19 mm) taller than stock for taller riders, listed for the 2019-2023 YZ250F and YZ450FX and the 2020-2023 YZ250FX.

source.name: Yamaha Motor USA accessories: Yamaha Tall Seat

records.topic: Yamaha tall seat accessory (+19 mm), YZ450F
records.statement: Yamaha sells a tall seat about 3/4 in (19 mm) taller than stock for taller riders, listed for the 2018-2022 YZ450F; the 2023-on bike is not on the list.

source.name: Yamaha Motor USA accessories: Yamaha Tall Seat

records.statement: Yamaha's 2020 YZ125/YZ125X owner's service manual: front brake lever position (lever-to-grip distance in the figure) is 100 mm as standard, adjustable over 86-105 mm with the adjusting bolt and locknut, with no free play at the lever end; the cable clutch needs 7.0-12.0 mm free play at the lever; brake pedal height is set with an adjusting nut and locknut, standard height 0.0 mm above the top of the footrest (level with the peg); installing the lower handlebar holders the other way round changes the bar's fore-aft offset.
records.notes: Yamaha manuals do not print the size of the holder offset.

records.statement: Yamaha's 2021 YZ250/YZ250X owner's service manual: front brake lever position (lever-to-grip distance in the figure) is 100 mm as standard, adjustable over 86-105 mm with the adjusting bolt and locknut, with no free play at the lever end; the cable clutch needs 7.0-12.0 mm free play at the lever; brake pedal height is set with an adjusting nut and locknut, keeping the adjusting bolt end at least 2.0 mm from the pedal; installing the lower handlebar holders the other way round changes the bar's fore-aft offset.
